label: Campbell & Bozorgnia (2008)
units: PGA, PSA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Campbell & Bozorgnia (2008)

site.anchor_note: Site nonlinearity via k1/k2/k3 is given for PGA.

coefficients.needed: The period-dependent SPECTRAL table for fmag + fdis + fflt + fhng + fsite + fsed. PGA anchor coefficients c0-c12 and k1-k3 with the full aleatory decomposition are now available.

implementation_notes: Rupture geometry must be supplied explicitly, never derived from a single distance measure.
Published short-period rule: PSA must not fall below PGA where the paper specifies it.
Hanging-wall flags depend on geometry, not on distance alone.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: NGA anchor; rupture geometry, hanging wall, sediment/site effects.
parameters.component_note: Still not named. The appendix publishes both a total sigma and an arbitrary-component sigma, which implies the median is for a defined average horizontal component - confirm which from the paper.

resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmin 0.07 km (rrup)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmax 199.27 km (rrup)
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code I50; OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/campbell_bozorgnia_2008.py declares IMC.GMRotI50
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/campbell_bozorgnia_2008.py coefficient table; period count and range (21 periods, 0.01-10 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked.
